name: bilingual-translate
title: Bilingual Translate
description: Translate selected, clipboard, or manually entered text with your own API key
author: yuukiLike

commands.name: translate-text
commands.title: Translate Text
commands.subtitle: Bilingual Translate
commands.description: Enter text and show the original with its translation

commands.name: translate-selection
commands.title: Translate Selection
commands.subtitle: Bilingual Translate
commands.description: Translate selected text, falling back to the clipboard

commands.name: translate-selection-copy
commands.title: Translate Selection and Copy
commands.subtitle: Bilingual Translate
commands.description: Translate selected text and copy the result

commands.name: translate-selection-paste
commands.title: Translate Selection and Paste
commands.subtitle: Bilingual Translate
commands.description: Translate selected text and paste the result into the frontmost app

preferences.name: provider
preferences.title: Provider
preferences.description: The selected provider is the only service that receives text

preferences.name: targetLanguage
preferences.title: Translation Direction
preferences.description: Auto translates Chinese to English and other text to Simplified Chinese

preferences.name: deepseekApiKey
preferences.title: DeepSeek API Key
preferences.description: Used only when DeepSeek is the selected provider

preferences.name: openaiApiKey
preferences.title: OpenAI API Key
preferences.description: Used only when OpenAI is the selected provider

preferences.name: googleApiKey
preferences.title: Google Gemini API Key
preferences.description: Used only when Google Gemini is the selected provider

preferences.name: anthropicApiKey
preferences.title: Anthropic API Key
preferences.description: Used only when Anthropic is the selected provider

preferences.name: azureApiKey
preferences.title: Azure Translator API Key
preferences.description: Used only when Azure Translator is the selected provider

preferences.name: azureRegion
preferences.title: Azure Resource Region
preferences.description: Leave blank for a global single-service Translator resource

preferences.name: deeplApiKey
preferences.title: DeepL API Key
preferences.description: Used only when DeepL is the selected provider

preferences.name: cacheEnabled
preferences.title: Translation Cache
preferences.description: Keep translations locally for 90 days to reduce latency and API cost
preferences.label: Cache translations locally

preferences.name: debugMode
preferences.title: Debug Mode
preferences.description: Record sanitized request metadata without text, API keys, headers, or response bodies
preferences.label: Record sanitized diagnostics

scripts.build: node ../scripts/validate-provider-config.mjs && node scripts/sync-catalog.mjs --check && ray build -e dist -o dist
scripts.check: node ../scripts/validate-provider-config.mjs && node scripts/sync-catalog.mjs --check && ray lint && tsc --noEmit && node --test test/*.test.ts
